scope: Final developer cleanup after the agreed PNG integration: comments/docstrings, consolidated documentation, unused files and generated artifacts. Gameplay statements, player-facing strings, level data and active media were preserved.

pytest.coverage_scope: Core, realtime movement, Gymnasium API, persistence, campaign, story, six ending first views/replays/save-load, PNG layout and lobby branches; see tests/ for assertions.

reference_replay.scope: Executed current GameCore against recorded v0.2 witness action sequences; not independent correctness proof.
limitations: No PPO or other learning was performed.
No claim about human difficulty, real-time input, UI or Windows execution.
All tested phase combinations use the authored routes and directions.

comment_cleanup.independent_method: Compare parsed AST after removing docstrings; comments are excluded by Python AST parsing. All independently checked runtime/UI ASTs match pre-cleanup snapshots.
comment_cleanup.edit_time_evidence_limit: The tools/tests agent asserted equality while editing all 37 files. Their original source snapshots were not retained, so this group is not labelled an independent recheck. One obsolete audio generator was later removed.

visual_comparison.method: RGB pixel hashes compared with captures from immediately before comment cleanup; memory originals and masks were also regenerated with preserved pre-cleanup UI source.

happy_all.narration: 저주에서 풀려나 다시 고양이가 된 세 친구와 함께, 까망이는 저택에서 오래오래 행복하게 살았답니다.

sad.narration: 까망이가 돌아온 저택에는, 친구들의 작은 흔적만 조용히 남아 있었답니다.

ghost_a.narration: 까망이는 고양이로 돌아온 보송이와 벽난로의 온기를 나누며, 저택에서 오래오래 행복하게 살았답니다.

ghost_b.narration: 까망이는 고양이로 돌아온 도레와 저택을 떠나, 나란히 달리며 세상 곳곳으로 즐거운 여행을 이어 갔답니다.

ghost_c.narration: 까망이는 고양이로 돌아온 이파리와 마을에서 가장 아름다운 정원을 가꾸며, 꽃향기 가득한 여유로운 나날을 보냈답니다.

normal.narration: 저주는 아직 풀리지 않았지만, 까망이는 세 유령 친구와 함께 저택에서 따뜻한 나날을 보냈답니다.

data_and_active_asset_preservation.baseline: Working tree immediately before developer file cleanup, after PNG integration
data_and_active_asset_preservation.level_metadata_decision: Keep original level bytes and config hashes; validation/upgrade_report.json now redirects to README and this report.

cleanup_inventory.note: Counts include original provenance/license locations copied to assets/ and reports regenerated before removal; cache cleanup is excluded. See current README for retained structure.

documentation_corrections: Magnet collects only value-1 warmth, not value-3 warmth.
Level coordinates, time budgets and authored route ticks were reconciled with current data.
balance_test.py collects human realtime play sessions; evaluate.py and reference routes use grid control.
Gymnasium external limit argument is max_episode_steps.
The no-damage badge storage key is quiet.

not_performed: Training PPO, DQN or another RL policy
Realtime learned-policy performance, generalization or human difficulty evaluation
Windows executable packaging or packaged-device launch
Full human playthrough or human audio listening
